title: A Distribution-to-Distribution Neural Probabilistic Forecasting Framework for Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2603.25370v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic forecasts provide a principled representation of forecast uncertainty through predictive distributions. Directly propagating predictive distributions with conventional physical models requires solving distributional evolution equations, a task well-known to be computationally prohibitive for high-dimensional nonlinear systems. Consequently, multi-step predictive distributions are commonly approximated using ensembles or sampled trajectories. A novel distribution-to-distribution (D2D) neural probabilistic forecasting framework is proposed with compatible distributional encoding and decoding interfaces around a replaceable neural forecasting module. Kernel mean embeddings represent input distributions, while mixture density networks parameterise outputs, enabling recursive multi-step forecasting in distributional form. translated_title: 面向动力系统的分布到分布神经概率预测框架
translated_abstract: 概率预测通过预测分布为预测不确定性提供了有原则的表示。使用传统物理模型直接传播预测分布需要求解分布演化方程，而对于高维非线性系统，这一任务在计算上是众所周知的难以承受的。因此，多步预测分布通常使用集合或采样轨迹来近似。本文提出了一种新颖的分布到分布（D2D）神经概率预测框架，该框架在一个可替换的神经预测模块周围配置了兼容的分布编码和解码接口。输入分布采用核均值嵌入表示，输出则由混合密度网络进行参数化，从而能够以分布形式进行递归多步预测。该框架在Lorenz63系统上进行了演示，结果表明D2D模型能够捕获非……
tldr: 本文提出了一种分布到分布（D2D）神经概率预测框架，利用核均值嵌入编码输入分布、混合密度网络参数化输出分布，实现了动力系统的递归多步概率预测，避免了求解计算代价高昂的分布演化方程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distribution-to-distribution (D2D) neural probabilistic forecasting framework that uses kernel mean embeddings for input distributions and mixture density networks for outputs, enabling recursive multi-step forecasting in distributional form while avoiding the computationally prohibitive task of solving distributional evolution equations.
